description: TealTiger deterministic governance guardrail — PII detection, prompt injection blocking, secret detection, cost governance, and structured audit evidence. No LLM in the governance path, <5ms evaluation.

mode.label: Governance Mode
mode.description: ENFORCE (block violations), MONITOR (log only), or OBSERVE (passthrough)

description.text: Detect and block PII (SSN, credit cards, emails, phone numbers) in prompts and responses using 40+ regex patterns. Returns structured findings with category and confidence.
Comma-separated PII categories to detect: ssn, credit_card, email, phone, iban, passport. Default: all.
Detect API keys, tokens, private keys, and credentials in prompts and responses. Covers OpenAI, AWS, GitHub, Slack, and generic patterns.
Enforce per-request cost ceilings based on estimated token usage. Block requests that would exceed the configured budget.
Maximum allowed cost in USD for a single request. Default: 0.50
